Senior Python Developer

Company: Acme Technologies
Location: Remote
Type: Full-time

About the Role:
We are looking for a Senior Python Developer to join our backend engineering
team. You will build and maintain scalable APIs and data pipelines that
serve millions of users.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of professional Python development experience
- Strong experience with FastAPI or Django
- Experience with PostgreSQL and Redis
- Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
- Familiarity with AWS services (EC2, S3, Lambda)
- Strong understanding of REST API design principles
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines
- BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with microservices architecture
- Experience with message queues (RabbitMQ, Kafka)
- Experience with monitoring tools (Grafana, Prometheus)
- Open source contributions
- AWS or GCP certifications

Nice to Have:
- Experience with Go or Rust
- Experience with machine learning pipelines
- Public speaking or technical writing experience

What We Offer:
- Competitive salary ($150K-$200K)
- Remote-first culture
- Health, dental, and vision insurance
- 401(k) with company match
- Annual learning budget
